title: Victim identified in fatal Thunder Bay police shooting
article: The man who was shot by a Thunder Bay Police Service (TBPS) officer has been identified as Michael Kolisnyk, 51 years of age.
His identity was confirmed during a post mortem examination that determined Mr. Kolisnyk died from a fatal gunshot wound.
Four SIU investigators remain in Thunder Bay to conduct interviews with police and civilian witnesses.
The investigation is continuing and anyone who witnessed this incident is asked to contact the SIU at 416-622-2038 or 1-800-787-8529.

The SIU is a civilian agency that investigates circumstances involving police and civilians which have resulted in serious injury, sexual assault or death. Under Part VII, Section 113, of the Police Services Act, the director of the SIU has the sole authority to decide whether or not charges are warranted based on the findings of a complete investigation.
The director's decision is reported to the Attorney General.
